name: Mitten Extracts Max Disposable | Peach Mango Gelato
description: Peach Mango Gelato is a balanced hybrid bursting with juicy peach and tropical mango flavors, complemented by creamy, dessert-like undertones. Offering a smooth, uplifting high with relaxing effects, it’s perfect for any time of day when you want to stay balanced and blissful.
